reviews.shade: Treecell Night Collagen Shampoo #Midnight Forest Set (360ml+120ml)
reviews.text: Хороший очищающий шампунь..нежный аромат..удобный флакон ..так же в наборе тревел версия..туба..удобно брать с собой. Нежная пенка..на голове на коже ощущается лёгкое охлаждение как ментоловое что то..освежает..очищает..состав направлен против выпадения волос. Мне понравился..рекомендую. не жирнит волосы.
reviews.zh: 好好嘅洗頭水……味道溫和……樽裝好用……套裝入面仲有旅行版本，軟管裝……方便攜帶。溫和嘅泡沫……頭皮上會有少少清涼感，好似薄荷咁……清新……清潔……配方針對頭髮脫落。我好鍾意……推薦。唔會令頭髮油膩。

reviews.shade: Treecell Night Collagen Shampoo #Midnight Forest Set (360ml+120ml)
reviews.text: This set came with the treatment. I like the cooling feeling and scent of this shampoo. I'm not sure how effective it is towards hair loss benefit.
reviews.zh: 呢套裝附送護理（treatment）。我鍾意呢款洗頭水嘅清涼感同味道。我唔太確定佢對防脫髮嘅效果有幾好。

reviews.shade: Treecell Night Collagen Shampoo #Midnight Forest Set (360ml+120ml)
reviews.text: Nice feel to it, my scalp feels nice and moist after use, will update the feedback after a few more uses. The scent is not to strong for me personally.
reviews.zh: 用落感覺幾好，用完之後頭皮感覺滋潤，幾多次之後我再更新反饋。香味對我嚟講唔會太濃。

reviews.shade: Treecell Night Collagen Shampoo #Midnight Forest Set (360ml+120ml)
reviews.text:
I really like the scent of this shampoo it feels luxurious 
The product cleans hair and scalp well helps with odor and makes hair softer too but I'm not sure that this shampoo suits my hair 
Sometimes I feel that this shampoo makes my hair fall out worse but again I'm not sure if its the product or other factors
reviews.zh:
我真係好鍾意呢款洗頭水嘅味道，感覺好奢華。
呢款產品清潔頭髮同頭皮都好好，有助除去異味，頭髮亦都更加柔軟，不過我唔肯定呢款洗頭水啱唔啱我嘅頭髮。
有時我覺得用咗呢款洗頭水之後，頭髮會更加跌，不過我又唔肯定係產品嘅問題定係其他因素。

reviews.shade: Treecell Night Collagen Shampoo #Midnight Forest Set (360ml+120ml)
reviews.text: The Treecell Night Collagen Shampoo leaves hair soft, shiny, and strengthened with a refreshing herbal scent. Great for nourishing and revitalizing hair naturally.
reviews.zh: Treecell Night Collagen Shampoo 令頭髮柔軟、有光澤，又帶有清新草本香味，變得更強韌。非常適合自然滋養同令頭髮重新煥發活力。

reviews.shade: Treecell Night Collagen Shampoo #Midnight Forest Set (360ml+120ml)
reviews.text:
Not what I expected.
Don't fill the results yet
Using the product for a month don't see the difference.
reviews.zh:
同我預期唔同。
仲未感覺到效果。
用咗一個月，都睇唔到有咩分別。

reviews.shade: Treecell Night Collagen Shampoo #Midnight Forest Set (360ml+120ml)
reviews.text: For more thorough and relaxing bath and cleansing of scalp and hair. I can see pretty much good reviews about this shampoo so let’s hope for the best….
reviews.zh: 用嚟令洗頭同清潔頭皮更徹底、更放鬆。我見到好多人對呢款洗頭水都好評，希望一切順利……

reviews.shade: Treecell Night Collagen Shampoo #Midnight Forest Set (360ml+120ml)
reviews.text: The first time I used it, I wasn't very impressed... until the next morning. Overnight, this shampoo keeps working and repairing my hair. I've now used it three times and I am so happy with the results. I will be repurchasing.
reviews.zh: 第一次用嗰陣，我唔太覺得有咩特別……直到第二朝先有感覺。過咗一晚，呢款洗頭水會繼續發揮修護頭髮嘅作用。我而家已經用咗三次，對效果好滿意。我會再買。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
